paper_statement: On the standard Pipe Flow benchmark, Geo-NeW obtains mean per-sample normalized L2 error 0.112e-2, a 71% reduction from LaMO at 0.38e-2.
source_anchor: main.tex, Section 4.4 and Table 2; Appendix Table 5 and Table 6
assumptions: The standard 1000-train/200-test Pipe split and 16641-node meshes are used.
Geo-NeW uses P=32 and the paper's 5000-epoch training configuration.
The reported mean per-sample normalized L2 metric is computed on the held-out test set.
The released implementation and preprocessing reproduce the paper model rather than a proxy architecture.

acceptance.verified: Independent evaluation of a released checkpoint, or CPU retraining with the complete released pipeline and uncertainty across deterministic seeds, reproduces both the absolute error and reduction within a predeclared tolerance.
acceptance.falsified: A faithful evaluation or adequately powered faithful retraining satisfying every assumption contradicts the reported result.

required_inputs: exact Pipe training configuration including optimizer details
released Pipe checkpoint or feasible faithful retraining
rejection_rule: Source-table transcription, a toy mesh, a different model, a partial split, or an untrained forward pass cannot yield VERIFIED or FALSIFIED.
